text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after Manhattan Cafe and I have seized a number of victories…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Look… The wind is blowing something around. What could it be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pick up the paper tumbling about on the ground… and find that it looks familiar.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Isn't that… the hot spring ticket we won in the raffle the other day?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: None of this makes any sense. What's this ticket doing here? I know I put it somewhere safe…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Wait… we have a problem. We have to use this hot spring ticket before it's too late…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is something going to happen? Has she seen some kind of ill omen?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It is almost upon us… The expiration date.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And back to the present. After quickly arranging some time off, we head towards the hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm soaking in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe sure is taking her time in the hot spring. Just as I start to worry…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… My friend…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She drowned in the hot spring…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She sank beneath the waters… I suppose she wasn't used to the springs…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not being used to the hot springs is one thing, but drowning is another entirely…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's fine… I don't think she needs air… She waved to me as she went down.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But… I felt a little lonely. Since she's… always with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe looks apprehensive. While I'm thinking of ways to help…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer… You're quite similar to my friend, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Just for today… in this room, could you… stand in for my friend?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod without saying a word, then try to imagine I'm her friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… The food is delicious…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you like some?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Wait… Can you even eat?
choice_data_list: I… I don't think I can…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I didn't think so… You never usually eat…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Can I eat yours instead?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Do you want it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I struggle to ignore my hunger pangs and stay in character as an inhuman entity.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's okay… You don't have to pretend anymore. You're not my friend…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But even though you're not, I've come to realize that's for the best…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: When you're with me… I have a different kind of fun…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I hope we can talk about many more things together…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Freed from my acting duties, I feel a little more relaxed. It looks like I'm safe to go on being myself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Listen closely. Here, come to the window…
choice_data_list: Are we listening for the insects?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No… I can hear something dragging itself out of a body of water…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It sounds like… My friend… has gotten out. She's coming this way…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Squelch, squelch, squelch…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe, she's almost here… Look, through the window…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Now that the three of us are all together… What shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Don't worry… The night is young…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In a panic, I grab the cushion I'm sitting on and put it over my head. After that… everything's a blur.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I sense that Manhattan Cafe and I have formed an irreplaceable bond during our time together.
